segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Off-price value retailer of trendy fashion apparel, accessories and home goods for the entire family, focused on Black customers.
segments.evidence: The retail operations represent a single operating segment based on the way the Company manages its business.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for apparel, footwear, accessories and home products at everyday ticketed low price points in its stores.
revenueModel.evidence: Our everyday ticketed low price points offer superior value, enabling our customers to purchase multiple items per visit.
